title: Sayonara o Oshiete ~Comment te Dire Adieu~

sources.title: さよならを教えて 攻略 (shisnap)
sources.notes: Directly inspected detailed Japanese PC walkthrough: common days 1-3, day-4 save, all five heroine routes and day-9 branch choices, day-11 endings, three save positions and one CG variant note. The walkthrough does not name its edition explicitly and appears to reflect the original Windows PC game; direct applicability of its literal choices and all ending behavior to the 2016 DLsite download edition remains UNVERIFIED.

sources.title: 『さよならを教えて』（2001）プレイ感想 (kqck, DLsite purchase)
sources.notes: Directly inspected detailed first-hand Japanese 2026 play log: author says the copy was purchased on DLsite and explicitly recounts the day-9 five-way heroine-selection prompt, selection of 御幸 and movement to 図書室, heroine-specific episodes and ending, plus a failed 望美 attempt that reached the bad ending and required replay from day 3. Important partial independent evidence for the Windows DL distribution, but product ID and all literal route-defining choices, affinity requirements, and endings are not verified; DOES NOT QUALIFY AS COMPLETE SET B. Day-5 rooftop three-choice interaction quotes the full 「それだけの情報ではわからない」 (source A abbreviates to 「それだけの情報では」) and records an unfavorable reaction followed by a reload; this does not prove the option blocks the ending. Full text is now directly attributed to this Set-B lane for Nozomi step 7, but the affinity outcome is disputed.

sources.title: さよならを教えて ～comment te dire adieu～ (ゲームカタログ@Wiki)
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese release/system source: original 2001 PC, 2011 BD, 2016 Windows DL release; five heroine locations; up to three heroine progress tracks before day 9; the normal route ending requires choosing the heroine with whom the player is most familiar at the late branching decision. Prints a day-5 three-choice example and confirms choices may not match what the protagonist actually says. Supports gate-relevant preselection affinity behavior but NOT all exact choices, save states, or individual endings.

sources.title: さよならを教えて | みこりすと
sources.notes: Independent Japanese completed-playthrough report lists five heroine routes and a personal completion order, but not a full actionable choice-by-choice guide. Cannot fill the Set-B gate.

sources.title: DLsite VJ009745 (Windows download edition)
sources.notes: Exact-edition product identifier/URL. Direct page inspection blocked by browsing, but multiple independently inspected Japanese pages reproduce and link this exact product number. The 2016 edition uses a rewritten Windows 10 compatible engine and changes some presentation effects; its exact choice sequences and CG equivalence to the original PC edition still need verification.

sources.title: さよならを教えて (ゲームなんでも評価wiki)
sources.notes: Japanese release/platform reference confirms the original Windows package (2001), BD-PG (2011), and Windows DLsite edition (2016-01-29). Does not supply route steps.

sources.title: YMGal game/release/character listing
sources.notes: Structured game database used to check the newest native-Japanese official complete Windows release and identify route characters. Portraits verified by opening the respective YMGal character records and image links: ca87306, ca98709, ca87304, ca98713, ca98715.

sources.title: DLsite product mirror/description VJ009745
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese summary quoting the download edition's Windows 10 engine rewrite, presentation changes, and added message-back/load behavior. Product art lookup attempted here and on image search, but no reliably attributable exact-edition cover could be verified.

sources.title: 〖ギャルゲー〗さよならを教えて | 雨雲レーダー
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese completed-play report explicitly says Windows 10, download purchase, five endings, no patch, and provides actual heroine play order. This materially supports target-era gameplay and five main endings but does not print exact route-defining decisions, so remains supplementary Set B, not qualifying alone.

sources.title: さよならを教えて 感想 - こんこんちきな日記
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese ending-structure analysis distinguishing the no-heroine bad ending from heroine-selected endings; recommends bad ending then four non-Mutsuki heroines then Mutsuki. Does not show reproducible choices for either path and is not independently tied to VJ009745; supplementary only.

sources.title: ゲーム「さよならを教えて」感想｜はずき
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese first-hand play report: five heroine route segments, shared normal/bad-ending structure, and bad-ending trigger hypothesized (not verified) as inadequate affinity before day-9 heroine selection. Does not independently establish exact choices; supplementary only.

sources.title: さよならを教えて — 腕がビリビリ (2016 DL edition review)
sources.notes: Directly inspected contemporary Japanese DL-edition review. Confirms saving is possible at choice menus, unlike 2001 PC. Supports system behavior only; does not verify route choices or uniquely prove edition.

sources.title: 『さよならを教えて』全CGタイトル一覧 — AQL日記 (2016-07-25)
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese catalog of all CG titles and in-game scene recollection titles, including each of the five heroine routes. Corroborates scene titles appearing in Set A (which abbreviates some names using ～) and the shared 門 recollection; this does NOT identify all choices, confirm their ordering, or demonstrate target DL-edition route equivalence. Scene names are not player choices.

sources.title: 20240701（『さよならを教えて』感想①） — 壁打ち
sources.notes: Independent Japanese first-hand completed-CG account indexed in search: author notes that combinations of heroine affection ranks yield different intermediary conversations, even with all CG collected. Readily visible excerpt is partial; NOT a full Set B and cannot establish exact branch states. Follow up only if this affects proposed 100% scope.

sources.title: 『さよならを教えて ～comment te dire adieu～』感想、考察 — エロゲ日記（仮） (2022)
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese owner play report: purchased in April 2020, describes small DL edition differences and reports a creator statement about one deleted CG, but says that same CG still appeared in this author's copy. Contradictory/unclear change report; no exact choice-by-choice comparison, no definitive claim a CG was actually removed. This is version-difference context only, NOT Set B.

sources.title: 四文字のおまじない — れうる・ぞあ・あるら (2026-03-12)
sources.notes: Independent written Japanese full-route completion report, directly inspected. Identifies five heroine paths and a bad-ending result, but is a commentary with screenshots and no complete actionable day-4–9 choices, save-state transitions or exact-edition identifier. Supplementary B only; not qualifying for source gate.

sources.title: 〖エロゲ〗さよならを教えて 感想 — 徳田 杏
sources.notes: Independent written Japanese retrospective describing five heroine locations and the repeated school-day visit loop; no exact route choices or edition equivalence. Supplementary structural corroboration only, not qualifying Set B.

sources.title: さよならを教えて ～comment te dire adieu～の感想・考察 — えす山の日記 (2023)
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese written day-by-day play report (common days 1–11, day-9 late branching, heroine-specific Mutsuki reflections and route ending); independent evidence for overall day progression and a main ending. The author explicitly says routes other than Mutsuki were skimmed. It does not list literal choice texts, save states, affinity flags, or every heroine's executable path, and does not establish exact VJ009745 release. Supplementary Set B only; cannot independently validate route files.

sources.title: 〖さよならを教えて〗巣鴨睦月ルート〖終〗 — 私だ (2018, five-route written play diary)
sources.notes: Directly inspected first-hand Japanese written article (and links to author's five-route 2018 diary series). Author initially hit BADEND after attempting 睦月, explicitly says heroine favor was insufficient, restarted from the beginning and then completed 睦月's route. Independent supporting evidence that choosing the day-9 girl alone may fail; NOT a choice-by-choice route guide, does not show exact actions needed to repair the affinity, and does not prove the exact 2016 VJ009745 edition. Supplementary B only.

sources.title: さよなら… 今、全ての人に贈る最期の言葉。— 孤高の在り処 (written five-route review)
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese written all-character review: author says saves made after entering a heroine route display that heroine's name, and the heroine paths reuse the same ending and epilogue with individual route-text variations. Mentions actual in-game selectable phrase フェラチオさせる also present in Set A's Koyori-related day-5 subscene, without specifying all preceding state/sequence. No complete route choices or exact 2016-edition identification; supplementary B only. Do not infer a save-slot label before branch selection.

sources.title: さよならを教えて — 積まないためのゲーム日記 (2013 completion review)
sources.notes: Independent 2013 written Japanese completion report predates the 2016 target. Reports BAD then heroine-branch clears and quotes all three options of the recurring angel-dream response including 彼女は天使であって天使ではない and 絶対に違う！ that appear in abbreviated form in Set A. Partial literal-choice corroboration for an older build only; cannot establish 2016 VJ009745 parity or cover the five route paths. Supplementary B, not a full independent route walkthrough.
